jobs.title: ServiceNow QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description BETSOLs team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. For each software publisher brought into scope, the team analyses contracts, models entitlements and consumption, and delivers a custom publisher view and dashboard that shows licenses owned, licenses consumed and the resulting compliance position. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources. We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT. Key responsibilities Testing SAM publisher implementations Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output. Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover. Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not. Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts. Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line). Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances. Building and running test automation Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines. Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight. Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks. Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers. Quality process and reporting Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current. Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT. Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment. Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early. Qualifications Required qualifications Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience. Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance. Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries. Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from. Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr. Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to walk stakeholders through test results and to discuss your own past work in depth. Preferred qualifications ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); a Certified Implementation Specialist in Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM) is a strong plus. Exposure to software licensing models for SaaS and enterprise publishers (named user, subscription, resource or consumption based). Experience testing REST API integrations and vendor usage exports. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary Meet the Team Our outstanding team works in a startup atmosphere within a stable and leading corporate environment, and our design center hosts all silicon Hardware and Software development fields under one roof. Our devices are crafted for universal adaptability, delivering high speed without sacrificing programmability, buffering, power efficiency, scale, or feature flexibility. We enable the use of these innovative products in the fast-paced world of Open Standards, Open Networking, and massively Scalable Cloud Data Centers. If you want to work with amazing people and innovative customers developing the next generation of world-class products, join us! Our team develops the full software stack enabling the Silicon One network processors. We work with the Open Standards community and our incredible customers to deliver best in class routing and switching platforms. Work also with architecture and design teams to define the next generation of ASIC products being developed. Your Impact Responsibilities As part of Silicon One Software team, you will closely interact with Cisco s Silicon One customers to help with Silicon One product adoption, software development, documentation, technical support, trouble shooting, and maintenance. You will gather information from customers on their requirements, pain points and help them implement in software to improve software quality and customer experience. You will gain intimate knowledge of the Silicon One hardware architecture and software programming models, working closely with the architecture, hardware and software teams. You will develop innovative applications, customizations of Silicon One software to better suit the customer s needs. You will work with Silicon One Software teams to design and development of software features for both the control plane and data plane on Cisco s Silicon One NPU. Youll play a critical role in creating software that powers highly scalable, low-power, low-latency, and dense systems, addressing the ever-growing demands of AI/ML workloads, internet users, and modern applications. You will use modern C++, the Silicon One network processing language, and Python to develop software for the NPU. You will participate in customer discussions to define requirements, scope features, and drive the development process from start to finish along with lead engineer(s) in the organization. Youll take full ownership of delivering high-quality software on schedule, additionally, youll gain deep expertise in the Silicon One hardware architecture and programming models, collaborating with architecture and hardware teams to shape the next generation of ASIC products. You are an experienced software engineer who understands software development methodologies to develop software modules for the networking domain. Your experience spans multiple areas in networking, where youve worked with other senior engineers/leads to develop and support various Networking Software modules. Your expertise in control and routing planes, as well as your ability to build large-scale, high-density, and highly redundant systems, is widely recognized. You are deeply committed to ensuring the quality of the software and systems and supporting Silicon One Software for our customers. As a member of the Silicon One Customer Engineering team, you bring optimism and a positive outlook to your work. Driven by self-motivation, you exhibit a strong sense of ownership and a passion for delivering exceptional results. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor of Science EE/CS combined with 0-1 year of related experience or Master of Science EE/CS Prior expertise in software development and integration while using one or more of the following programming languages: C++, Python. Prior expertise with networking protocols and technologies (e.g., L2/L3, MPLS, BGP, OSPF). Prior expertise in analytical reasoning and debugging, with experience using tools such as GDB, PDB, etc. Prior working experience with algorithms and data structures. Preferred Qualifications Experience with cloud, data center, or edge networking products. Experience with SAI, SONiC or other Network OS. Experience with writing, testing and supporting software for high performing and scalable networking products. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. 0-1 Yrs Cisco, OSPF, Data, Python, Software engineering, C++, Debugging, Technical

About the Role We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the design, quality, and delivery of features across our student-facing web applications. This role is focused on building React/Next.js product experiences, the GraphQL-powered data layers behind them, and increasingly, AI-powered study features (step-by-step solutions, Q&A, and personalized study assistance). You will also contribute across the stack as needed this is a frontend-first role with full-stack reach, and you should be comfortable enough with backend concepts and AWS infrastructure to ramp into our Java or Python backend services when a task calls for it. What You'll Do Own frontend features end-to-end architecture, implementation, testing, staged rollout, and production monitoring across student-facing web application. Translate product requirements into component architecture, GraphQL query/schema boundaries, and client-state contracts (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar) that other engineers build on. Debug cross-system issues that surface in the UI GraphQL supergraph errors, auth/session edge cases, server/client rendering mismatches by tracing root cause across the stack. Build AI-powered study features responsibly: validate model output (e.g., step-by-step solutions, Q&A answers) before it reaches the UI, design graceful fallbacks for unusable or low-confidence responses, and instrument these flows with telemetry. Apply security and data-protection practices input validation, secure auth/session handling, careful treatment of student data as a default part of the code you ship, not a step someone else checks for. Optimize application performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals) as an ongoing part of feature work, particularly for high-traffic student study flows. Own the quality of your changes through automated tests (unit, component, and end-to-end), CI stability, and production validation. Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend to deliver and harden high-impact student workflows (search, Q&A, subscription/paywall flows, study tools). Contribute to engineering quality through strong code reviews including review of AI-generated code reusable patterns, shared components, and clear documentation that keeps technical debt low. Ship end-to-end changes across the web application and its supporting APIs/schema, as needed. Required Qualifications Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of features from design through launch. Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js, and comfort working in TypeScript. Working knowledge of web fundamentals common security pitfalls (XSS, CSRF, auth/session handling), performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals), and accessibility (WCAG/ARIA basics) and the judgment to apply them without being told to. Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms GraphQL (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real-time protocols such as WebSockets and working with at least one modern client-state approach (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar). Strong testing and release-validation discipline unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress). Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce. Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically. Preferred Qualifications Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, basic service architecture) and some Node.js backend exposure enough of a foundation to ramp into our Java or Python backend services when needed. Experience with Auth0 or similar authentication providers in a Next.js application. Experience shipping AI-powered UI streaming responses, structured output rendering, graceful handling of model failures. Experience contributing to shared component libraries or tooling used across multiple teams/repos. Familiarity with frontend observability tooling (New Relic or similar). Experience in EdTech, e-commerce, or another high-traffic, subscription-based consumer product company. Tech Stack Frontend: React (18/19), Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo tooling, codegen against a shared supergraph), React Query / Redux Toolkit / Zustand, styled-components, MUI Backend (foundational): Node.js, AWS (compute/storage/networking basics) enough to ramp into Kotlin/Java (Spring) or Python (FastAPI/Django) services owned by backend engineering Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright Auth / Delivery: Auth0, GitLab CI Observability: New Relic AI / ML: OpenAI, RAG, MCP, AWS Bedrock (via shared backend integrations) 4-5 Yrs Software, Kotlin, Node.js, Nextjs, Java, Graphql, Software engineering, Generation
